summary: This bill extends a program to improve the United States Drought Monitor until 2030, establishes an interagency working group to enhance drought data and methodologies, and requires the Farm Service Agency and Forest Service to align their drought response activities.

scores.thoughts: The bill extends a program for improving the United States Drought Monitor and establishes an interagency working group to enhance data availability and quality. These activities would require some level of government funding and resources, indicating a slight increase in spending, though the bill does not specify appropriations.
